problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 20 infrastructure projects to maximize the total community benefit score.
The profile for each project is as follows:
* Project A: benefit score is 0.134, impact factor is 0.279, allocation range [0.076, 0.495]
* Project B: benefit score is 0.098, impact factor is 0.227, allocation range [0.044, 0.338]
* Project C: benefit score is 0.069, impact factor is 0.133, allocation range [0.075, 0.473]
* Project D: benefit score is 0.195, impact factor is 0.016, allocation range [0.078, 0.727]
* Project E: benefit score is 0.144, impact factor is 0.286, allocation range [0.028, 0.796]
* Project F: benefit score is 0.064, impact factor is 0.084, allocation range [0.067, 0.653]
* Project G: benefit score is 0.169, impact factor is 0.199, allocation range [0.060, 0.681]
* Project H: benefit score is 0.170, impact factor is 0.266, allocation range [0.091, 0.497]
* Project I: benefit score is 0.152, impact factor is 0.253, allocation range [0.068, 0.533]
* Project J: benefit score is 0.114, impact factor is 0.136, allocation range [0.027, 0.858]
* Project K: benefit score is 0.103, impact factor is 0.044, allocation range [0.041, 0.308]
* Project L: benefit score is 0.034, impact factor is 0.066, allocation range [0.002, 0.504]
* Project M: benefit score is 0.087, impact factor is 0.086, allocation range [0.041, 0.508]
* Project N: benefit score is 0.046, impact factor is 0.098, allocation range [0.013, 0.567]
* Project O: benefit score is 0.196, impact factor is 0.159, allocation range [0.027, 0.577]
* Project P: benefit score is 0.135, impact factor is 0.258, allocation range [0.060, 0.746]
* Project Q: benefit score is 0.179, impact factor is 0.081, allocation range [0.098, 0.426]
* Project R: benefit score is 0.089, impact factor is 0.242, allocation range [0.032, 0.719]
* Project S: benefit score is 0.196, impact factor is 0.119, allocation range [0.022, 0.704]
* Project T: benefit score is 0.034, impact factor is 0.147, allocation range [0.002, 0.453]

Each project must receive a budget share within its specified allocation range, and all shares must sum to one. To prioritize essential services, the subset of core projects L = {B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R, S, T} must collectively receive at least 0.807 of the total budget. Additionally, the city's total environmental impact index must not exceed 0.195, and the overall community benefit score must be at least 0.106. Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all requirements.
